reason: Each FR-05 requirement maps to an assertion that fails if it is violated. Capacity (BURST=20): 03-development/tests/test_fr05.py:132 and :149 need exactly 20 successes, and :150 needs a 429 after that. Refill rate: :136 and :203, where 1s at 2.0/s gives exactly 2 tokens and the third request gets 429. Per-token: :189 fails if the bucket is shared. HTTP 429 and problem+json: :134, :165, :168, :172. Retry-After in seconds: :164 (int parse) and :202 (exact value 1). Bucket state in the database across workers: :315-316 and :319, where 40 concurrent requests give exactly 20 successes and one rate_buckets row. Row-level lock: :285, where every bucket SELECT must compile to FOR UPDATE on the postgresql dialect. Single transaction: :287, one begin and one commit around the read and write. Health endpoints: :334 and :342, where /healthz and /readyz never return non-200 after the bucket is drained. Weak assertions (:284 tautology, :321 >=0, :170 >=1) are backed by real ones on the same behaviour.
